status: DRAFT for owner review. Not locked. No confirmation task has been generated or run.

owner_direction.decision_5: Draft and review B1 v5 before locking it. Make accuracy with examples present the primary gate, compare against matched compute, and include the valid-code guessing control.
owner_direction.decision_6: Pin the unseen Qwen checkpoint before downloading. Name the host, storage path, and exact revision. Reserve the model for confirmation.
owner_direction.open_question: Decision 5 can be read two ways. Both are written below as gates A and B; the owner picks which is primary before the lock.

claim: A support table can be compiled, in closed form and with no gradient step, into one low-rank update on one MLP layer of a frozen model, such that the model with the table removed answers unseen questions as accurately as the unmodified model does with the table in its prompt, at lower time per question.

tasks.generator: tasks_v5.py, split 'confirm' (eight item groups never used in development)
tasks.confirmation_seed: to be drawn at lock time, >= 2000000
tasks.unit_of_analysis: the question, paired across arms; per model and per setting, never pooled across models

arms.base_ctx: base model, table in the prompt (accuracy with examples present)
arms.top2_ctx: fixed adapter, table in the prompt
arms.v5_bare, v5_ctx: secondary: adapter with layer and ridge selected per table by leave-one-out

A_adapter_without_table_matches_base_wit.pass: top2_bare accuracy is at least base_ctx accuracy minus 5 points, and exact two-sided McNemar does not show top2_bare worse at 0.05
A_adapter_without_table_matches_base_wit.note: This is the gate the mechanism is built for.

B_adapter_with_table_beats_base_with_tab.pass: top2_ctx accuracy is higher and exact two-sided McNemar p < 0.05
B_adapter_with_table_beats_base_with_tab.note: Stricter. In development the fixed adapter with the table scored 343/448 against 312/448; one of seven runs reached p < 0.05.

C_above_guessing.comparison: top2_bare against a rate of 0.25 (one of four valid codes)
C_above_guessing.pass: one-sided binomial p < 0.01, and the valid-code rate of every arm is reported

D_cost.comparison: mean time per question, top2_bare against base_ctx, same machine and run
D_cost.pass: top2_bare is faster; compile time per table and the number of questions needed to repay it are reported
D_cost.matched_compute_note: A cached copy of the prompt would give base_ctx accuracy at close to base_bare time. It is reported as the strongest conventional alternative; the adapter's case against it is size (hundreds of kilobytes) and freed context, not accuracy.

E_do_no_harm.pass: exact two-sided McNemar does not show top2_ctx worse at 0.05

unseen_confirmation_model.status: not chosen; owner pins host, storage path and exact revision before any download
unseen_confirmation_model.constraint: must add its MLP output straight to the residual stream; a Doppler Q4K build avoids porting the compiler to PyTorch

models.out_of_scope: gemma-3-270m-it (post-feedforward norm); its v4 failure stands as reported

frozen_at_lock: fixed adapter: top two layers, ridge 0.15, write strength 0.15 of the median final hidden RMS per layer
procedure: Two commits. Commit 1 locks this file with status LOCKED and the SHA-256 of the frozen files, before the confirmation seed is drawn. Commit 2 adds the receipts and the write-up. The confirmation runs once per model and setting.
primary_adapter: fixed: top two layers, ridge 0.15 (the `top2_*` arms). Development showed the per-table selected adapter (`v5_*` arms) is worse; it is kept as a reported secondary arm.
development_evidence: RESULTS.md: seven dev runs, 448 questions. Fixed adapter with the table removed 331, base model with the table 312.
